scope: Read-only review of all four train/test pairs on original-resolution source images, plus comparison of saved normalized pHash, SHA-256 results, and cached CLIP vectors.
review_outcome: Three candidates are classified as distinct images of the same or similar scenes and are not called duplicates. Pair 535889/465129 is a strong near-duplicate candidate at Hamming distance 2 and remains unresolved as to source provenance.

pairs.visual_evidence: Very similar kitchen interior and camera viewpoint; small image/scene details differ.
pairs.reason: Same kitchen layout and near-identical viewpoint, but broad pixel differences exceed a simple recompression signature. Treat as separate selected images depicting the same kitchen view; source-provenance uncertainty remains.

pairs.visual_evidence: Same bus and street viewpoint; bus position and surrounding details differ.
pairs.reason: The buses have visibly different body/front designs, route displays, positions, and street details. This is a similar urban bus scene, not an image duplicate.

pairs.visual_evidence: Very similar restaurant storefront and sidewalk viewpoint; people/details differ.
pairs.reason: Same restaurant storefront and viewpoint, while pedestrians and other foreground details differ materially. This is best classified as a different capture of the same place/scene, not an image duplicate.

pairs.visual_evidence: Same kitchen and person composition; visible pose/details differ.
pairs.reason: Original-resolution images have the same 640x480 framing and nearly identical scene/pixel structure; small localized pose/detail differences are visible. Strong near-duplicate evidence. Distinct SHA-256 values rule out byte-identical files but do not distinguish a recompressed derivative from a near-identical adjacent capture.

action: No manifests or images were changed. Keep these pairs flagged for research-owner review because the shared frozen split constraint forbids silent replacements.
exact_duplicate_finding: No reviewed cross-split pair has matching SHA-256. The preserved dataset-wide audit reports zero exact duplicate groups.
remaining_uncertainty: For pair 535889/465129, metadata does not identify image-source provenance. The files may be recompressed/derived versions or distinct near-identical captures; visual evidence cannot establish which.
decision: WARNING ? retain the pair and keep Phase 1 incomplete until the dataset owner resolves the cross-split near-duplicate risk. Frozen manifests are not changed.
